mapper.insert: insert into t_receipt (enterprise_id, receipt_no, order_id, receipt_type, total_qty, receiver_id, receiver_name, receipt_time, remark, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{receiptNo}, #{orderId}, #{receiptType}, #{totalQty}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverName}, sysdate(), #{remark}, sysdate())
insert into t_receipt_item (enterprise_id, receipt_id, order_item_id, product_id, qty, price, amount) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{receiptId}, #{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{qty}, #{price}, #{amount})
mapper.select: select r.receipt_id as receiptId, r.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, r.receipt_no as receiptNo, r.order_id as orderId, r.receipt_type as receiptType, r.total_qty as totalQty, r.receiver_id as receiverId, r.receiver_name as receiverName, r.receipt_time as receiptTime, r.remark as remark, r.create_time as createTime, o.order_no as orderNo from t_receipt r left join t_purchase_order o on o.order_id = r.order_id where r.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and r.order_id = #{orderId} order by r.receipt_id desc limit 1

select r.receipt_id as receiptId, r.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, r.receipt_no as receiptNo, r.order_id as orderId, r.receipt_type as receiptType, r.total_qty as totalQty, r.receiver_id as receiverId, r.receiver_name as receiverName, r.receipt_time as receiptTime, r.remark as remark, r.create_time as createTime, o.order_no as orderNo from t_receipt r left join t_purchase_order o on o.order_id = r.order_id where r.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and r.receipt_id = #{receiptId}

select ri.item_id as itemId, ri.receipt_id as receiptId, ri.order_item_id as orderItemId, ri.product_id as productId, ri.qty as qty, ri.price as price, ri.amount as amount, p.product_name as productName, p.product_code as productCode from t_receipt_item ri left join t_product p on p.product_id = ri.product_id where ri.receipt_id = #{receiptId} order by ri.item_id
